programs.title: My Penguin Friend
programs.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programs.title: Gone Mom: The Disappearance of Jennifer Dulos
programs.desc: Police investigate Fotis Dulos when his wife, Jennifer, mysteriously disappears after driving their five children to school.

programs.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programs.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth.

programs.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programs.desc: Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.

programs.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programs.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher.

programs.title: Flamin' Hot
programs.desc: Richard Montanez, the son of a Mexican immigrant, was a janitor at Frito-Lay when he came up with the idea for Flamin' Hot Cheetos. His creation, inspired by the flavors of his community, revitalized Frito-Lay and disrupted the food industry.

programs.title: Venom: The Last Dance
programs.desc: Eddie Brock and Venom must make a devastating decision as they're pursued by a mysterious military man and alien monsters from Venom's home world.

programs.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programs.desc: Deadpool's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the Time Variance Authority recruits him to help safeguard the multiverse. He soon unites with his would-be pal, Wolverine, to complete the mission and save his world from an existential threat.

programs.title: The Moment
programs.desc: As her arena tour debut looms, a pop star finds herself caught inside the afterglow of a breakout summer under the mounting pressure of what it costs to stay on top.

programs.title: Balestra
programs.desc: Joanna is a competitive fencer who is desperate to be the world's best. In order to gain an edge, she pursues an experimental technology, allowing her to train through lucid dreaming, where she begins a tumultuous affair with her instructor.

programs.title: Chris Locke: Captain Bones
programs.desc: From Montreal, the comic delivers hilarious takes on everything from chip flavors and sausage rolls to kids' brains and vasectomies.
